overview.description: The Guruvayur Sri Krishna Temple is situated in the town of Guruvayur, Thrissur district, Kerala, India. Located approximately 26 kilometers (16 miles) northwest of Thrissur city, the temple stands as one of the most revered and actively visited Hindu pilgrimage sites globally. Dedicated to the deity Guruvayurappan, a beloved form of Vishnu, the temple is affectionately hailed by devotees as Bhuloka Vaikunta—the Holy Abode of Vishnu on Earth. In terms of foot traffic, it is one of the busiest Vaishnava shrines in the country.

topPlaces.name: Mammiyur Mahadeva Temple
topPlaces.description: Ancient Shiva temple with exquisite mural paintings and separate sanctums for Mahavishnu, Ganapathi, and Subramanya, traditionally visited alongside Guruvayur.

image.alt: Mammiyur Mahadeva Temple in Guruvayur Temple, Kerala

topPlaces.name: Punnathur Kotta (Anakkotta Elephant Sanctuary)
topPlaces.description: Historic 10-acre palace estate of Punnathur Raja converted into a sanctuary housing over 50 elephants dedicated to temple service.

image.alt: Punnathur Kotta (Anakkotta Elephant Sanctuary) in Guruvayur Temple, Kerala

topPlaces.name: Chavakkad Beach & Estuary
topPlaces.description: Serene coastal beach where the Chettuva backwater estuary meets the Arabian Sea, featuring coconut groves and calm golden sands.

image.alt: Chavakkad Beach & Estuary in Guruvayur Temple, Kerala

topPlaces.name: Palayur Historic Syrian Church
topPlaces.description: Historic church founded by St. Thomas the Apostle in 52 AD, displaying centuries-old granite stonework, copper bell towers, and sacred Thaliyakulam pond.

image.alt: Palayur Historic Syrian Church in Guruvayur Temple, Kerala

items.note: Devaswom Museum is a museum located at Guruvayur in Thrissur District showcasing rare offerings of devotees to the Guruvayur Temple. The museum exhibits temple materials, antiques, musical instruments, mural paintings, adornments used in folk arts like Krishnanattam and Kathakali, elephant teeth of Guruvayur Keshavan.

Guruvayur IPA: [guɾuʋɐːjuːr]) is a municipal temple town in Thrissur district, of Kerala State in India. It is a suburban town of Thrissur city, located 26 kilometres (16 mi) from Thrissur towards the north-west.

Mammiyur Mahadeva Temple is a popular Shiva temple situated in Guruvayoor, Thrissur district of Kerala, India. Every devotee who goes to Guruvayur Temple is supposed to go to Mammiyoor also, as the ritual goes.

Palayur Mahadeva Temple (Malayalam: പാലയൂർ മഹാദേവക്ഷേത്രം) was a legendary temple located in Palayoor near Chavakkad in the Thrissur district in ancient Kerala. This Shiva temple was later converted into a Christian church with the arrival of St.

Sree Perunthatta Siva Temple (Malayalam: ശ്രീ പെരുന്തട്ട ശിവ ക്ഷേത്രം) is an ancient Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva situated in Guruvayur of Thrissur District in Kerala state in India. According to folklore, sage Parashurama has installed the idol of Lord Shiva in the Treta Yuga.
Iringaprom is a census town in Thrissur district in the Indian state of Kerala.

Palayūr, also called Palayoor and historically as Palur, is a town near Chavakkad, Thrissur district, India. It is famous for its ancient church, Palayur Mar Thoma Church, which is believed to be one of the seven major churches founded by Saint Thomas the Apostle in Malabar in 52 AD. It is the assumed to be first Christian Church in India.

Palayur Mar Thoma Major Archiepiscopal Church, is located at Palayur (historically known as Palur), in Thrissur district in Kerala on the west coast of India. According to Saint Thomas Christian tradition, the Syrian church is believed to be established in 52 AD by St Thomas, one of the twelve apostles of Jesus Christ.

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Guruvayur Temple?
faq.a: The best time to visit Guruvayur Temple is Nov – Feb. Summers are 26–36°C and winters are 22–32°C.

faq.q: How do I reach Guruvayur Temple?
faq.a: The nearest airport is Guruvayur Temple / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Ernakulam Junction (Kochi) (75 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.

faq.q: How many days are enough for Guruvayur Temple?
faq.a: 3 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Guruvayur Temple at a relaxed pace.

faq.q: How much does a hotel cost in Guruvayur Temple?
faq.a: Stays in Guruvayur Temple start from ₹900 per night, with options across 4 price categories.

faq.q: What are the top places to visit in Guruvayur Temple?
faq.a: The top attractions are Devaswom Museum, Guruvayur, Mammiyoor Temple, Palayoor Mahadeva Temple, Sree Perunthatta Siva Temple.
